jobs.title: CA Inter and Finance Support
jobs.description:
This role supports finance, accounting, audit-related and taxation work, with attention to the records and documentation behind each task.

Rapid's published role description invites candidates with CA Intermediate study or a background in the CA course who can demonstrate relevant knowledge and practical ability.
jobs.responsibilities:
Support financial and accounting tasks, prepare and organise records, assist with audit and control-related work within the assigned responsibility, and use Excel and Word for analysis and documentation.

The ability to explain a figure, check an input and maintain a clear record is important. Work should be understandable to the colleague or professional reviewing it.
jobs.requirements:
A grounding in accounting, finance and taxation, confidence with spreadsheets and documents, careful organisation and the ability to solve a practical information problem.

Be ready to explain the work you have performed yourself and where it was supervised or reviewed.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description: Help keep daily work organised and moving. The Executive Assistant role supports administrative tasks, document handling, data entry and communication within Rapid's team.
jobs.responsibilities:
Prepare and maintain documents, support reporting in Excel and Word, organise information needed for tasks and communicate clearly with colleagues and clients within the assigned role.

Good coordination means knowing what has been requested, what has been received and what needs a follow-up. It also means making records easy for someone else to locate and understand.
jobs.requirements:
A commerce background, practical Excel and Word skills, accurate typing, clear communication and good organisation. Rapid's published description identifies a bachelor's degree as preferred.

Bring examples of how you have handled records, coordinated a task or resolved an information gap. Explain your own contribution and how you checked the result.

jobs.title: Accountant
jobs.description: Support reliable financial work through accurate records and clear documentation. The Accountant role involves maintaining financial information, preparing statements and assisting with the accounting tasks assigned to the team.
jobs.responsibilities:
Organise and update financial records, support preparation of statements including balance sheets, work with income-tax-related information and use Excel and Word for analysis and reporting.

Every figure should have a clear basis. The role calls for checking records, identifying discrepancies and making the work usable by the person reviewing it.
jobs.requirements:
Rapid's published description specifies a commerce degree, knowledge of accounting and income tax, familiarity with financial statements and practical Excel and Word ability.

Attention to detail and organisation matter throughout the work. Be ready to discuss a financial record or statement you have prepared and explain how you checked it.

advisers.name: Atul Goyal
advisers.bio: Atul Goyal is the founder of Rapid Consulting, a Hisar-based firm supporting businesses across Haryana with subsidies, statutory approvals and related project requirements.
